facts.statement: The festival centers on a special flower planted by the pixie couple, still blooming and standing out from the sunflowers in Vegalegre with red, pink and magenta colors.
facts.quote: Se destaca del resto de los girasoles en Vegalegre por sus colores rojo, rosa y magenta.

article_summaries.title: El Festival anual de Corazones ha Regresado (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing the return of the annual Festival of Hearts in Vegalegre, with its love story of the pixies Rois and Araiana, daily and members-only quests, Station Cash and Coin Shop items, and new outfits arriving the following week. It also describes the villain Stone Heart (Corazón Pétreo), who appears when the special flower blooms and whose annual arrival inspires some Cash Shop and Coin Shop items. The page gives no exact post date; the relative stamp '4 months, 1 day ago' against the 2011-06-04 capture implies about early February 2011, which is an inference.
